candidates.gap: Small-to-moderate strain stiffness reduction and damping in natural soils
candidates.rights: Article CC BY 4.0; supplement linked by article; no separate notice in ZIP (only MAT and XLS). Check any per-source exclusions before release.
findings: 252 test sheets: 110 RC and 142 CDSDSS; 2642 rows with numeric shear-strain and modulus pairs.
Shear strain %, modulus MPa, G/G0 and damping % explicitly labelled.
OCR numeric in 123 of 252 sheets; preserve missing values in remaining sheets.
Includes sample location, depth, index and grading properties; completeness varies.
limits: Reduced response curves, not raw cyclic stress-strain-time histories.
252 tests do not imply 252 independent materials/specimens.
candidates.next_action: Map all curves and available metadata; confirm supplement release terms and protocol applicability before adding public records.

candidates.gap: Locally measured triaxial response and small-strain stiffness
candidates.rights: Dataset API metadata explicitly cc-by-4.0; version 1.3.
findings: Three drained constant-mean-effective-stress triaxial tests; nominal p levels 130, 300 and 400 kPa.
Axial strain %, volumetric strain %, mean effective stress kPa and deviator stress kPa are labelled separately from derived tangent stiffness.
84, 78 and 103 rows respectively contain all four numeric stress/strain channels (265 total). Other stiffness points are separate views.
Three grading sheets and two bender-element sheets, with specimen dimensions and water/density information.
limits: Tests at 130, 300 and 400 kPa use intact material from 8, 18 and 21 m respectively: depth/material variation is confounded with stress level.
No timestamps in the stress-strain table; not evidence for rate/creep or unloading/reloading.
Need resolve strain signs and bender pressure reference from companion methods before normalization.
candidates.next_action: Extract source-preserving stress-strain curves, specimen metadata and stiffness summaries separately; audit local-strain methods and sign conventions.

candidates.gap: London Clay response under constant-vertical-stress simple shear
candidates.rights: CC BY 4.0 in API, workbook README and dataset PDF.
findings: Fig 5.xlsx / Fig. 5c distinguishes experimental columns A:F from model results H:M.
Three experimental curves at vertical stress 388, 194 and 49 kPa; 26, 21 and 20 numeric shear-strain/stress pairs respectively.
Source attributed to Lau (1988); strain in %, stress in kPa.
limits: Reproduced source curves; acquisition resolution and complete preparation history not established.
Most other workbooks are simulation/emulator/field/geometry data, not element-test histories.
Oedometer and other validation data mentioned on landing page live in separately cited datasets; not actually present in this workbook.
candidates.next_action: Recover original Lau protocol/preparation, retain reproduced-curve provenance, and map only experimental columns.

candidates.gap: Undrained response of clay embankment fill with pore-pressure change
candidates.rights: CC BY 4.0 in repository API; experimental/model distinction explicit in workbook.
findings: Fig 8.xlsx contains two experimental groups of three curves, separate from model predictions.
Effective confinements 50.7/100.6/197.7 kPa and 100/200/300 kPa.
Each experimental triplet labels axial strain %, change in pore pressure kPa and deviator stress kPa.
49/21/45 and 21/21/21 complete numeric triplets respectively (178 rows).
limits: Confirm group identities, density/preparation, saturation/drainage, initial pore pressure and specimen histories from methods.
Do not infer absolute pore pressure from the change channel.
Related Newcastle compilation cites the same measurements: do not count as independent replication.
candidates.next_action: Read companion methods and preserve distinct groups; compare source identities against other Newcastle assets before ingestion.

candidates.gap: Drained multistage creep in saturated clay shale
candidates.rights: CC0 declared on repository landing page.
findings: Landing page links RAW_DATA.zip and READ_ME.pdf for long-term strength and creep of saturated shaly Opalinus Clay.
limits: Direct URLs returned 248-byte HTML web-challenge pages, not data/PDF; no test-channel, time-history or specimen-count verification.
Clay shale is a separate material class from soft clay.
candidates.next_action: Obtain original archive/readme through ordinary repository access; verify content before selecting timed comparisons.

candidates.gap: Bedding and temperature dependence of clay-shale creep
candidates.rights: CC0 declared on repository landing page.
findings: Repository lists experimental archive and readme for bedding-orientation/temperature creep study.
limits: Readme URL returned the same 248-byte HTML challenge; files not verified.
Not a soft-clay or linear-viscoelastic validation dataset by default.
candidates.next_action: Obtain original readme/archive and screen loading stages, thermal history and drainage.

candidates.gap: Bedding-oriented CU response in Boom Clay
candidates.rights: CC BY 4.0 declared on repository landing page.
findings: Sample TMX-BoC 07: loading parallel to bedding in CU triaxial testing, up to 7% axial deformation; linked wider dissertation data compilation.
limits: File-list request returned an HTML web challenge; archive not retrieved or screened.
One specimen is not a compression-extension/OCR family.
candidates.next_action: Retrieve loading archive and follow wider compilation; verify whether matched orientations and histories are available.

candidates.gap: Fluid-injection-driven accelerating shear creep and localization
findings: Repository contains 40 MAT measurement files and a protocol-summary workbook.
Summary distinguishes pre-sheared histories and lists simulated slope angles, loading rates kPa/h, elapsed times s and slip mm.
limits: Raw MAT histories not downloaded/parsed in this pass.
Shear slip/localization experiment is not a homogeneous triaxial strain history; do not convert slip to strain without a justified geometry/kinematic model.
Useful for a separate friction/shear-zone capability, not direct evidence for current bulk clay creep models.
candidates.next_action: Lower-priority specialist dataset: read methods and define compatible geometry/observable contract before full acquisition.

candidates.gap: Matched monotonic/non-monotonic compression and extension in soft organic clay
candidates.rights: Article open access does not establish redistribution permission for author-supplied raw measurements.
findings: 2025 Chao, Muraro and Jommi study documents organic diatomaceous clay under monotonic and non-monotonic compression/extension stress paths.
Data availability statement: available from corresponding author upon request.
limits: No public raw-data archive established in this pass; no data acquired or permission assumed.
candidates.next_action: Prepare request for all measured histories, preparation/initial-state metadata and permission for attributed redistribution; do not send without user authorization.

candidates.gap: Soft-clay rate changes, stress relaxation and creep across temperatures
candidates.rights: Institutional manuscript page states personal-use restriction; no raw-data hosting grant established.
findings: Study reports temperature-controlled CRS compression-relaxation at multiple rates and multistage oedometer creep, 20-55 degrees C.
limits: No public measurement archive established.
Manuscript access alone does not supply machine-readable histories or grant measurement redistribution.
candidates.next_action: Prepare request for paired time/load/displacement histories, drainage and thermal equilibration metadata, and explicit data reuse/hosting terms; do not send without authorization.
